import sys

def read():
    return int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

def write(x):
    sys.stdout.write(str(x))

def qpow(x, n, MOD=1000000007):
    ans = 1
    while n:
        if n & 1:
            ans = (ans * x) % MOD
        x = (x * x) % MOD
        n >>= 1
    return ans

def main():
    P = read()
    K = read()
    
    if K == 0:
        write(qpow(P, P - 1))
        return
    
    if K == 1:
        write(qpow(P, P))
        return
    
    vis = [False] * P  # Using list instead of array
    step_count = 0
    p = 1
    while not vis[p]:
        step_count += 1
        vis[p] = True
        p = (K * p) % P
    
    write(qpow(P, P // step_count))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
